item.description: A battle over who runs parking in Oakland The city’s finance department is on a fast track to take over parking enforcement from the department of transportation, alarming staff and business leaders. The turf dispute will get aired out at a Feb. 10 council committee meeting.

item.title: An endangered shorebird gets help from the East Bay Parks — and a small army of volunteers
item.description: An endangered shorebird gets help from the East Bay Parks — and a small army of volunteers A wildlife biologist with the park system has been working for nearly 30 years, with 8,000 volunteers, to create nesting habitats in Oakland and Hayward for the California least tern and other threatened shorebirds.
